inputs.name: hand over from Data Validation to Data Versioning

output.level_0: Data Validation fails silently, Data Versioning never receives input.
output.level_1: No process exists to transfer validated data to Data Versioning.
output.level_2: Team members manually copy validated data to Data Versioning.
output.level_3: A script automatically moves validated data to Data Versioning.
output.level_4: Validated data is automatically transferred with audit logs and compliance checks.
